title: Optimal convergence of adaptive BEM driven by functional-type error estimators
summary: In the present work, we derive functional upper bounds for the potential error arising from boundary element discretizations of the Laplace-Dirichlet problem. These bounds are based on local auxiliary problems on patches of boundary vertices and the resulting a posteriori error estimator is shown to be locally equivalent to the well-studied residual error estimator.
